description: Seven-panel composite figure of machine-learning goodness-of-fit scatter plots, each comparing predicted against actual yield strength (YS). All panels share identical axes — x "Actual Value/MPa" (0–3000) and y "Predicted Value/MPa" (0–3000) — plus a red dashed x = y diagonal reference line; panels differ only by model name, printed metrics and marker colour. (a) "DT Fitting Performance", magenta markers: R²=0.944, RMSE=123.0, MAPE=19.0%. (b) "XGBoost Fitting Performance", gold markers: R²=0.969, RMSE=90.4, MAPE=13.4%. (c) "LightGBM Fitting Performance", green markers: R²=0.959, RMSE=104.8, MAPE=12.7%. (d) "CatBoost Fitting Performance", orange markers: R²=0.970, RMSE=89.5, MAPE=10.2%. (e) "Extra Trees Fitting Performance", light-blue markers: R²=0.978, RMSE=76.2, MAPE=9.80%. (f) "KNN Fitting Performance", cyan markers: R²=0.973, RMSE=85.2, MAPE=10.4%. (g) "AdaBoost Fitting Performance", lavender markers: R²=0.901, RMSE=162.5, MAPE=33.1%. Data points are dense below roughly 1000 MPa and sparse above 2000 MPa in every panel; no individual point labels are printed. The figure demonstrates that all seven models reproduce the YS trend with points clustering along the x = y diagonal, Extra Trees being the most accurate and AdaBoost clearly the least.

observations.observation: All seven panels are parity (goodness-of-fit) scatter plots with identical axes: x = "Actual Value/MPa" and y = "Predicted Value/MPa", both spanning 0 to 3000 with ticks at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000.
Each panel contains a red dashed diagonal line representing the ideal x = y agreement, and circular markers of a different colour per model.
Panel (a) DT prints R²=0.944, RMSE=123.0, MAPE=19.0%.
Panel (b) XGBoost prints R²=0.969, RMSE=90.4, MAPE=13.4%.
Panel (c) LightGBM prints R²=0.959, RMSE=104.8, MAPE=12.7%.
Panel (d) CatBoost prints R²=0.970, RMSE=89.5, MAPE=10.2%.
Panel (e) Extra Trees prints the best metrics of the group: R²=0.978, RMSE=76.2, MAPE=9.80%.
Panel (f) KNN prints R²=0.973, RMSE=85.2, MAPE=10.4%.
Panel (g) AdaBoost prints the worst metrics of the group: R²=0.901, RMSE=162.5, MAPE=33.1%.
In every panel the scatter is dense between roughly 0 and 1000 MPa and sparse above 2000 MPa, and the points lie close to the red dashed diagonal, more tightly for Extra Trees than for AdaBoost.
Marker colour distinguishes the models: magenta for DT, gold for XGBoost, green for LightGBM, orange for CatBoost, light blue for Extra Trees, cyan for KNN and lavender for AdaBoost.

The caption maps the seven panels to models: (a) DT, (b) XGBoost, (c) LightGBM, (d) CatBoost, (e) Extra Trees, (f) KNN, (g) AdaBoost; the supplied caption string is partially garbled and out of order but its panel–model list matches the printed panel titles.

The citing text states that the four strengthening-mechanism values quantified from the GMM data-augmented dataset were used as model inputs with the corresponding YS as output, and the dataset was split into training and testing sets at a 7:3 ratio.
The citing text states that the seven selected models all showed good predictive performance for YS, with test-set points largely aligning with the x = y diagonal.
